label: late-episode D2: rare a1->S2 after an unrewarded trial
explanation: Fires only at D2 (DELAY_2), and only in the last ~10 trials of an episode (96% of mass in trials 90-99, none before trial 80), when the value head is low (99% of mass at value < 5.22). The strongest activations come at D2 when the agent chose a1, landed rarely in S2, and the previous trial was unrewarded (D1 reward input 0). They grow through streaks of repeated unrewarded a1->S2R trials and reach max after 3-4 in a row. Weaker activations occur on other late-episode D2 steps after no reward (e.g. a1->S1c, a2->S2c), which the predicate misses. Low-quartile coverage is only 10-16%, so the predicate gets the top quartile (99%) but not the weak tail. It never fires at D1 or GO, after a rewarded previous trial (4.5% of mass), or before trial 80. All variables are observed at D2. Dev P=0.75, R=0.43, mass recall 0.75. Broader clauses like late-episode D2 with low value and no reward reach mass recall 0.91 but precision 0.17.
